purpose: 无卡 harness 与真机的 topdown/IPC 一致性首次对照

harness.preset_meaning: max_model_len=2048, max_num_reqs=8, max_num_batched_tokens=2048, no prefix cache, async=on, gdn=on
harness.workload: batch=1, isl=128, osl=64, steady_seconds=600 (tight replay loop)

realmachine_reference.host: a3-22 Kunpeng 920B, real service on chip3

verdict.qualitative: MATCH - both are frontend-bound with IPC < 1 and latency-bound fetch stalls
verdict.direction: harness is OPTIMISTIC (reports the CPU as faster than it really is); the real bottleneck is at least as bad

judgement_vs_criteria.explanation: The 2-3pp / 10% criteria assume the harness reproduces the same cache/interference environment. It does not (tight loop, no scheduler/RPC/forward between steps, sync points no-op'd). These criteria are achievable only if the real-machine measurement is taken on the same sub-scope (LiteProfiler subscope) AND the harness injects the missing inter-step interference. The honest statement is: same regime, harness optimistic by 7-32%.

attribution: tight replay loop: better i-cache / iTLB / L1d locality than the real engine loop
missing inter-step work (scheduler, ZMQ RPC, forward launch, D2H) which pollutes i-cache and branch predictors on the real machine
synchronize_input_prep / Event.synchronize are no-ops in the harness (real machine may actually wait, issuing no instructions)
compute_slot_mapping numeric work skipped in noop mode

preset_sensitivity.purpose: same prepare_input code, only the engine start-up parameters change

rows.verdict: FAR from real machine - must not be used for consistency checks
